append.detail: RE-RULED 2026-11-18 (ADR-1978, owner: "make all the changes site wide to the new system"; pin rewrite approved by the owner the same day): the Network plan's own 2% fee is retired with the rest of the 5 / 3 / 2 ladder. Network pays the one finder's fee (10%, never more than $20, once per customer Frequency introduces).
